description: One week before absentee voting begins, retired Marine and firefighter Greene earns coveted business group’s endorsement in re-election bid to represent Michigan’s 35th Senate District SAGINAW, MI - Today, the Detroit Regional Chamber PAC announced their endorsement of State Senator Chedrick Greene in his re-election bid to represent Michigan’s 35th Senate District. The announcement comes…

title: Chedrick Greene for Michigan State Senate District 35. Marine, Fire Captain, Working Families Champion fighting for lower costs, better jobs & safer communities.
